def is_yellow(cell):
    fill = cell.fill
    if fill is None or fill.fill_type != "solid":
        return False
    color = fill.fgColor
    if color.type == "rgb":
        return color.rgb in ("FFFFFF00", "FFFF00")
    if color.type == "indexed":
        return color.indexed == 6
    return False

# Only modify cells in the allowed answer range G1:G2,

for row in range(1, 3):
    cell = ws[f"G{row}"]

        formula = cell.value
        if isinstance(formula, str) and formula.startswith("="):
            # Add the requested prefix so the concatenated output starts with "//["
            # Existing formula begins CONCATENATE("[",...)
            formula = formula.replace('CONCATENATE("[",', 'CONCATENATE("//[",', 1)
            cell.value = formula
